title: Kabocha and Aerated Wrap
description: A unique combination of kabocha squash and aerated chocolate in a crispy wrap. Perfect as a snack or dessert.
instructions: Cut the kabocha squash in half and scoop out the seeds.
Place the kabocha squash on a baking sheet and drizzle with 1 tbsp of honey.
Roast the kabocha squash in the oven for 30 minutes, or until tender.
Meanwhile, melt the aerated chocolate in a double boiler.
Warm the Brazilian wrap according to package instructions.
Arrange the roasted kabocha squash on the wrap, followed by the melted aerated chocolate.
Sprinkle with cinnamon powder to taste.
